title: The editor's domain is not the application's: its audience holds onto their own words; get it written or develop the ideas, own words or feedback, support or challenge (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
I think we are confusing many things here. 

There are multiple domains here, and domains can be nested nd overlapping so that's not a problem. 
But lets not mix them. The domain for the editor is not the domain for the application. 

The editor must server it's audience. It's audience is those wishing to hold onto their own words, and work with AI. Sometimes they may wantto build with evidence. Sometimes they may just want to build with structure and data. 

In that domain, they want to get the essay written   or  spend time developing the ideas. SRS supports both in the same place. 

They also need to manage writing with their own words  vs getting feedback on those words. This may still be the same axis. 

Then there is a challenge (in evidence backed writing ) to get support for your ideas or to challenge them
